messages:
nora: Quick follow-up from the tri-mode RFC: one open corner — how should we treat "exceptions" where an adapter wants to add a short freeform note about a fallback (e.g., 'model pinned by customer', 'experimental quantization') without increasing metric cardinality?

sam: Good question. We mustn't let freeform strings hit metrics. Proposal: 1) metrics only use fixed enums, 2) adapters may set a short 'reason_code' header that maps to a catalog of <code,description> stored in the control plane, 3) any freeform details go into traced payloads (sampled) or audit logs.

josh: +1 on reason_code. Keep codes short (alpha-numeric, <=10 chars). Example codes: PINNED, EXP_QAT, MODEL_FALLBACK. We can add a small lookup API so dashboards can link code->full text when investigating.

mika (sec): Security: reason_code is fine, but ensure the lookup service returns the description only to authorized users and that descriptions cannot contain tenant PII. For Private deployments, descriptions that are tenant-specific must live only in the customer's audit store.

nora: Nice. So headers might look like:
```http
X-RW-Hosting: DEDICATED
X-RW-Path: FALLBACK
X-RW-Bucket: perf
X-RW-Reason-Code: PINNED
X-RW-Telemetry-Sample: 1/1000
```
The exporter ignores Reason-Code for metrics but the incident UI can call the lookup API to show human text when viewing a trace or log.

sam: Also add a TTL and vetting process for new reason codes. We don't want unreviewed codes becoming a vector for accidental sensitive text. New codes should be created via RFC or admin UI and reviewed by security.

josh: For migration: runtime emits Reason-Code=NONE by default. Adapters may set a code if they have one. Control-plane stores code metadata and a 'public' flag (hosted dashboards can show public descriptions; private-only descriptions are hidden).

mika (sec): I'll add guidance to the telemetry policy: code creation requires security review; any code descriptions must be sanitized and not contain tenant identifiers. Private deployment exceptions documented separately. Also recommend rate-limit on lookup API and audit of lookups.

ops-bot: Note: mapping service maintenance window Fri 03:00-04:00 UTC. Tag @josh if you want the slot. :calendar:

nora: Action items: nora update RFC with Reason-Code catalog + header semantics; sam implement exporter ignore + telemetry sample; josh sketch lookup API + admin vetting flow; mika update telemetry policy. I'll drop the RFC patch by EOD.
